frames.board: B: origin at the first board corner, x along the board rows (to the image LEFT for a face-on upright camera, R_BC0 = diag(-1, 1, -1)), y down (gravity +y, vertical board), z = board normal toward the camera; metres
frames.camera: cam0: x right, y down, z optical axis; pitch = about x, yaw = about y, roll = about z
frames.quat: R_BC (camera -> board) as [w, x, y, z]; p_C = camera centre in B
frames.imu: gyro / accel in IMU axes: v_cam = R_CI v_imu, R_CI = T_CtoI[:3,:3]^T; *_cam fields are already rotated
frames.outline: 4 outer corners TL TR BR BL as seen by a face-on upright camera, then midpoints of TL-TR, TR-BR, BR-BL, BL-TL

segments.name: rest
segments.label: Hold still
segments.cue: Hold the camera still in front of the board.

segments.name: aimed_orbit_az
segments.label: 1  Left-right
segments.cue: Swing left and right around the board, 2.0 times (about 39 deg to each side, 7.4 s per left-right-left), turning to face it. Vary the speed, never a steady pace: push through the middle and brake into each end. At each end turn about 20 deg past the board so it slides to the left or right edge of the picture. Keep the whole chessboard in the picture.

segments.name: aimed_orbit_el
segments.label: 2  Up-down
segments.cue: Move up and down, 2.0 times (about 31 deg above and below the board, 7.0 s per up-down-up), tipping the camera to look at it. Vary the speed, never a steady pace: push through the middle and brake into each end. At the top and bottom tip about 36 deg past the board so it reaches the top or bottom edge of the picture. Keep the whole chessboard in the picture.

segments.name: depth_roll
segments.label: 3  Back-forth + roll
segments.cue: Move in to 0.28 m and back out to 0.80 m, 3 times (5.2 s per in-out). Vary the speed, never a steady pace: push through the middle and brake into each end. At the same time turn the camera like a steering wheel, up to about 60 deg each way, at its own pace (4.2 s per roll). Keep the board off-centre while you roll (aim about 40 deg beside it when far, 5 deg when near), so the roll carries it into the picture corners: the board on one side for the first in-outs, then on the other side for the last, crossing over during the middle one. Keep the whole chessboard in the picture.

segments.name: corner_square
segments.label: 4  Corner square
segments.cue: Stay where you are and turn the camera in place along a slow rounded square (about 22 deg left and right, 36 deg up and down), once in 9.6 s, so the board runs along the picture border into each corner. Keep the whole chessboard in the picture.
